items.decision_note: The South Pointe malware INTRODUCE Event uses a generic client reply supported by several preceding messages; review the immediate exchange to determine whether message 89 unambiguously accepts one concrete remediation proposal.

After removing active-malware observations from Oakbridge plugin hardening, review whether messages 143 and 148 independently establish an update, replacement, disablement, removal, or maintenance obligation distinct from malware eradication.
Review whether Oakbridge automated security monitoring was client-authorized in message 145 or remained a freelancer-originated setup; message 142 does not provide the required acceptance.

unresolved_candidate.description: XML-RPC was reported disabled, but the generic client acknowledgement does not safely establish whether this independently configurable restriction became a client-confirmed persistent Requirement.

The history discusses possibly migrating legacy pages to Elementor and later removing Thrive, but it is unclear whether full Thrive retirement was committed or remained a tentative future option; immediate Thrive Apprentice risk mitigation is covered by plugin hardening.
